# architecture diagrams

# NOTES:


- Restriction for length of the name for DB user
- Password policy for DB user
- Local User must be operated from Devadm (system user for local sandbox)
- In folder of dmp files (on DB server) will exist updated export in dmp file after our modifications (so 3 files every time latest dmp from dev,


previous dmp from dev, application support dmp)


- Before any drop of user we must verify the following
- create backup if it is needed
- gather from all users queries that will inject data from local development or/and local parameters
- After import of dmp we should
- run all previous queries on generic in order users import the updated dmp
- truncate table pcard_traces only on every local user (not in generic)

# NOTES:


- Restriction for length of the name for DB user
- Password policy for DB user
- Local User must be operated from Devadm (system user for local sandbox)
- In folder of dmp files (on DB server) will exist updated export in dmp file after our modifications (so 3 files every time latest dmp from dev,


previous dmp from dev, application support dmp)


- Before any drop of user we must verify the following
- create backup if it is needed
- gather from all users queries that will inject data from local development or/and local parameters
- After import of dmp we should
- run all previous queries on generic in order users import the updated dmp
- truncate table pcard_traces only on every local user (not in generic)
